records.name: WiSARD / WiSAR Image Dataset
records.population_or_scenario: Aerial wilderness search-and-rescue imagery; 26,862 labeled visual images, 29,989 thermal images, and 15,453 synchronized pairs per project page.
records.ground_truth: Human image annotations; not clinical injury labels.
limitations: Wilderness/aerial collection is not representative of indoor structural fires.
No clinically adjudicated injury outcomes.
License and downstream commercial rights require direct confirmation.

records.name: NOMAD — Natural, Occluded, Multi-Scale Aerial Dataset
records.version: WACV 2024 release; verify data package revision
records.population_or_scenario: 100 actors, 42,825 annotated frames, multiple aerial distances and visibility/occlusion conditions.
records.ground_truth: Human bounding-box and visibility annotations; not medical ground truth.
limitations: Actor sequences are staged dataset scenarios, not live emergency incidents.
Does not establish clinical condition or indoor fireground performance.
Dataset license and downloadable package must be checked before acquisition.

records.name: Low Altitude Disaster Imagery (LADI)
records.population_or_scenario: Civil Air Patrol low-altitude oblique airborne imagery collected for disaster response.
records.ground_truth: Human and machine annotations; no clinical victim outcomes.
limitations: Aerial disaster imagery does not establish indoor victim presence or injury.
Attribute source and verify any third-party components and dataset snapshot before redistribution.

records.name: BRIGHT — Multimodal Disaster Response Dataset
records.license_name: Component-specific terms; repository code has Apache-2.0; source imagery may have separate terms
records.version: Multiple dated releases; pin specific Zenodo record and file manifest
records.population_or_scenario: Disaster events across natural and human-made hazards; building damage mapping using optical and SAR imagery.
records.ground_truth: Building damage labels and benchmark splits; not interior structural integrity or victim condition.
limitations: Cannot infer interior room safety, structural stability, or victim condition from these labels.
Some optical imagery cannot be redistributed by dataset maintainers; source-level component rights must be reviewed.
Do not infer dataset rights from the code repository license.

records.name: MmodalFire — Indoor Fire Video and Physical Sensing Dataset
records.version: 2026 publication; resolve exact Figshare record and version
records.population_or_scenario: Controlled indoor combustion experiments across two laboratory locations, with video and physical sensing channels.
records.ground_truth: Experimental sensor measurements and scenario metadata; not human injury outcomes.
limitations: Controlled laboratory conditions do not represent all structural fires or live rescue operations.
Sensor outputs require units, calibration, synchronization, and reference review.
Dataset license and exact data package must be verified.

records.name: UL FSRI Fire Investigation Data Portal
records.version: Portal and experiment-specific releases; identify individual experiment IDs
records.population_or_scenario: Full-scale residential structure-fire experiments examining ventilation effects, fire patterns, and electrical-system damage.
records.ground_truth: Instrumented experimental measurements and documented test conditions; not victim clinical outcomes.
limitations: Experiment scope is specific; do not generalize to every building, fuel, or tactical condition.
Check rights and reuse terms for each downloadable artifact.
Not a substitute for calibrated WaveRadar field measurements.

records.name: 120 GHz mmWave Vital Signals with Synchronized References
records.version: 2026 dataset release; pin IEEE DataPort version and terms
records.population_or_scenario: 24 healthy adult volunteers; 5,760 seconds of radar data across resting and apnea scenarios.
records.ground_truth: Synchronized physiological reference instruments; healthy volunteers only.
limitations: Healthy-volunteer data do not establish performance in injured, unconscious, moving, smoke-exposed, or fireground victims.
Custom 120 GHz research radar is not equivalent to a phone or a different mmWave device.
No diagnosis or clinical deployment claim is supported.

records.name: M4Human mmWave Human Motion Benchmark
records.version: CVPR 2026 release; verify current data access and terms
records.population_or_scenario: 20 subjects, 50 motion classes and approximately 661,000 frames, including free-space motion.
records.ground_truth: Marker-based motion-capture annotations; no clinical injury labels.
limitations: Motion reconstruction is not victim identification or injury diagnosis.
Staged motion coverage is not equivalent to injured or incapacitated victim behavior.
Confirm data files and license before acquisition.

records.name: NEMSIS Trauma Public Use Dataset 2023
records.version: 2023 Trauma Public Use Dataset; request current copy and documentation
records.population_or_scenario: EMS trauma activations and supplemental long-format clinical/operational records.
records.ground_truth: Prehospital EMS records and impressions; not necessarily hospital-confirmed final diagnoses or complete population coverage.
limitations: Terms restrict use to specified not-for-profit purposes and prohibit sharing without advance written approval; not cleared for commercial WaveRadar training or redistribution.
Treat as non-public health data under the agreement.
Submission coverage varies by state and agency; EMS impressions are not equivalent to definitive diagnosis.

records.name: WHO Data Set for Emergency Care (DSEC)
records.population_or_scenario: Standardized data elements for emergency care presentations and prehospital/emergency-care workflows.
records.ground_truth: Not a patient dataset; a data standard.
limitations: Does not supply patient records, training examples, or clinical outcome labels.
Check WHO publication reuse terms before reproducing content.

records.name: MIMIC-IV-ED
records.license_name: PhysioNet credentialing and data use agreement
records.version: Pin PhysioNet release version before use
records.population_or_scenario: Deidentified emergency department stays from a hospital information system.
records.ground_truth: Hospital-recorded diagnoses and care events; no fireground sensor synchronization.
limitations: Credentialing and data-use requirements apply; commercial model use is not presumed permitted.
Hospital ED data are not prehospital rescue data and may not represent fireground populations.
No use until current access and license terms are reviewed.

records.name: RSNA Abdominal Traumatic Injury CT (RATIC)
records.version: RSNA 2023 challenge dataset; pin current terms and exact files
records.population_or_scenario: 4,274 abdominal CT studies contributed by 23 institutions across 14 countries.
records.ground_truth: Radiologist-generated imaging annotations; hospital CT modality.
limitations: Non-commercial use only under current terms; no commercial WaveRadar training or redistribution.
CT findings cannot be inferred from external thermal, RGB, radar, or phone sensors.
Hospital imaging data are not field triage ground truth.

records.name: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints
records.version: Use dated source release; record release and file manifest
records.population_or_scenario: Global building-footprint geometries derived from satellite imagery.
records.ground_truth: Geospatial footprint annotations; not interior floor plans, occupancy, or structural condition.
limitations: Footprints do not provide room geometry, floor count certainty, structural integrity, occupancy, or interior route safety.
Validate local currency, geometry quality and completeness before operational use.

records.name: OpenStreetMap
records.version: Use dated extracts and record extract timestamp/provider
records.ground_truth: Crowdsourced map data; coverage and verification vary by feature and location.
limitations: ODbL attribution and share-alike obligations require legal review for derived databases and distribution.
Completeness and positional accuracy vary; not a certified fireground map or interior floor plan.
